# Breathing Text (`fancy/breathing-text`)

A single word whose weight/width breathes slowly. Ambient only; never for status.

- **Weight**: 0.7 KiB JS + 0.1 KiB CSS (own, gzip); 49.6 KiB with vendor deps. **Lite**: true. **Touch**: true. **Reduced motion**: static.
- **License**: MIT, tier A, from `danielpetho/fancy@f9f62c61207b` by daniel petho.
- **Deps**: `motion`.

## Usage

```tsx
import { BreathingText } from "./kit/fancy/breathing-text";

<BreathingText as={…} fromFontVariationSettings={…} toFontVariationSettings={…} />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `as` | `ElementType?` |
| `fromFontVariationSettings` | `string` |
| `toFontVariationSettings` | `string` |
| `transition` | `Transition?` |
| `staggerDuration` | `number?` |
| `staggerFrom` | `"first" \| "last" \| "center" \| number?` |
| `repeatDelay` | `number?` |

## Compose

1. Inside a shell `.panel` as the screen's one hero element, with the headline in `--font-body` and labels in `.kicker`.
2. As a row in a list/card (`.item`, `.card`) where it is decoration for the text next to it — then it must be `aria-hidden`.

## Failure modes

- Animates font-variation-settings; only visible with a variable font (Air 'Newsreader'/'Azeret Mono' are variable).
- Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the final frame renders immediately; make sure that frame is complete.
- Pulls `motion` (shared with other motion components; counted once per app).

## Air tokens

Colours, radii and fonts come from `kit/air/theme.css` custom properties (`--ink`, `--accent`, `--panel-bg`, `--ring`, `--radius-*`, `--font-*`); pass them through `className`/`style`, never literals.
